description: This file defines the MainframeModernizationClient class, a client for interacting with AWS Mainframe Modernization services. It includes method annotations for various API operations, indicating that this class provides a structured interface for managing mainframe modernization tasks within AWS.

classes.name: MainframeModernizationClient
classes.description: A client class that extends AwsClient, providing methods to interact with AWS Mainframe Modernization services.
